title: Strangers stage 2b: arm C, with a walk along the Strand
about: Stage 2b (docs/STRANGERS.md): as `strangers-c`, but after its stand at the arrival point the newcomer walks the Strand as a player walks the town: down from the Counting House yard to the quay and west along it, past the Fish Steps (about 6 m off), where Ingrid Morrow mends; then it stands at the densest group. Plan-local to world: (510 + x, 784 - y); the Strand is y = 5.
